decisions: 0123 WAS FOUND APPLIED BUT UNCOMMITTED, and committed on sight. That is exactly the db-reset vector section 7 records - a replay rebuilds from COMMITTED migration files, which is how v_operations_by_driver_monthly was lost. Nothing was lost this time, but it was one reset away. Verify-then-commit the moment an apply is confirmed, without waiting to be asked.

THE TWO FINGERPRINT CHECKS ARE MIRRORS, AND BOTH MATTERED. 0123 required the metric_key fingerprint to stay IDENTICAL (b3bbb25d...), which is what proved a text-only change could not alter what the builder offers. 0124 required it to MOVE to a value asserted in advance (c4e9e453..., 29 keys -> 30), which is what proved exactly one key moved and not more. Same instrument, opposite expectations, each stated before applying.

0123 WAS NOT A FIND-AND-REPLACE. Two of the ten metrics are COMPOSED - v_payroll_monthly carries the staff/driver split and v_commissions_monthly four components, while v_pnl_by_period exposes only the combined total - so those two say 'combined total only' and the other four map directly. A uniform edit would have misled exactly the reader the gap existed to serve.

operating_margin IS THE DANGEROUS ENTRY. Widening a RATIO's grain invites the error 0100 exists to prevent, so its caveat now carries the proof: averaging the monthly margins for Q3-to-date gives +20.5% where the correct figure is -38.7%. It flips the sign. v_pnl_by_period recomputes per period; the risk is a reader doing their own arithmetic.

0124's CAVEAT IS WHY FILLING IS NOT A CLONE OF parts_cost. It is the only cost bucket with an uncosted companion, so the total is SHORT BY AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT rather than complete (live: 10 uncosted June, 3 July, 0 August). 0114 means the count is historical and fixed, but the historical total stays short. A SCHEDULED trip has not filled and is excluded entirely, so summing trips.filling_cost_sar raw EXCEEDS the view.

BUILDER-ELIGIBILITY TOOK TWO HALVES, AND THE ORDER WAS SAFE. A dictionary row alone does nothing: lib/report-builder offers a block only where BUILDER_METRICS and the live dictionary agree. Exactly one key was added there, plus a `filling` slot on Bucket - the figure was already fetched via PnlPeriodRow and simply never bucketed. The app shipped FIRST and was inert, because with the key absent from report_metrics availableMetrics filtered the row out: it fails CLOSED.

GROUPINGS ARE PERIOD-ONLY for filling, matching the four buckets around it. The figure comes from PnlPeriodRow, which is per-period; there is no per-customer or per-truck filling view, so offering those groupings would promise a number that does not exist.

lib/dashboard-widgets' WIDGET_CATALOGUE WAS DELIBERATELY NOT TOUCHED. Add Summary is a different surface - a Dashboard TILE with its own bilingual label, display modes, href and value plumbing. Builder-eligibility was the ruling. 0124's block G asserts filling does NOT appear there, so a stray addition gets caught.

FILLING AND operating_cost ARE A COMPONENT AND ITS CONTAINER, NEVER ADDENDS. Both are legitimate builder columns and the builder has no cross-column total by design (0100), so nothing sums them - but a reader might try.
